dama.operations

Class Check

  • java.lang.Object
    • dama.operations.Check

  • public final class Check
extends java.lang.Object
    Trida obsahuje staticke metody ke kontrole stavu hry po kazdem pul-tahu (vitezstvi, nutnost brani souperova kamene a zmenu pesce na damu).

    Roman Luks, Pavel Hala
